{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

{{TAG:0003:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:000A:}}KRAWUMM!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:000A:}}BUMM! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Bwa ha.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
